title.narrative: JCLEC has strengthened its capacity to deliver law enforcement training programs consistently and effectively, as planned in its annual work plan, leading to improved skills and knowledge among participating officers. Indicator to measure change: number of training sessions delivered by JCLEC as per the yearly work plan; and number of law enforcement personnel successfully completing the training programs each year.

Measures the total number of training sessions and activities successfully delivered by JCLEC within a given year as outlined in its approved yearly work plan. This indicator reflects JCLEC's operational capacity to implement scheduled programs that enhance the skills and knowledge of law enforcement personnel.

target.value: 1 consultation meeting on anti money laundering/counter financing terrorism 2 training on management of anti money laundering/counter terrorist financing 2 training on investigation and prosecution of money laundering and terrorist financing

title.narrative: Capacity building of local and regional law enforcement officers.

Measures the extent to which JCLEC has maintained and enhanced its institutional teaching capacity, as evidenced by the number and quality of training activities delivered annually, the number of trained law enforcement personnel, and participant feedback on the relevance and usefulness of training in their daily work related to preventing violent extremism, combating transnational crime, and upholding human rights.

target.value: Deliver anti money laundering/counter financing terrorism and investigation and prosecution of money laundering and terrorist financing trainings

actual.value: Conducted 4 courses on Management of Anti Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing and Investigation and Prosecution of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, with total 69 participants and 8 trainers. JCLEC also delivered a consultation meeting of anti money laundering/counter financing terrorism with 10 participants.

target.value: Expand human rights and anti money laundering/counter terrorist financing training; develop PVE curricula

actual.value: Delivered 12 courses with 215 participants and 32 trainers were conducted. - human rights training produced

target.value: Deliver PVE training; continue implementing anti money laundering/counter terrorist financing, human rights training; implement gender training

actual.value: Delivered 14 trainings with 236 participants and 24 trainers

target.value: Qualitative evidence as documented in JCLEC yearly reports shows that JCLEC has managed to maintain its teaching capacity and carried out more successful training activities that participants deem valuable for their law enforcement work when it comes to prevention of violent extremism and transnational crime, and with an eye to upholding human rights, peace and tolerance in Indonesia and the region.

actual.value: Maintained its teaching capacity and training quality; deliver more training on violent extremism prevention, human rights, and gender-sensitive training; ensure sustained participant satisfaction and alignment with with national security priorities.
